results.name: Flood in Norway
results.reason: On the 07 August 2023, the extreme weather Hans hit eastern/central part of Norway and is forecast to bring heavy rainfall. It is expected That heavy rainfall will produce floods in many places in Norway. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide flood extent emergency mapping.
results.activator: Norway|Directorate for Civil Protection and Emergency Planning (DSB)
